description.zh: 动作相关的参数，根据业务需要扩展，不同的taskAction名需传不同的值。
description.en: A action-related parameter. This parameter can be extended based on your business requirements. This parameter value varies with the value of the TaskAction parameter.
The region ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~61933~~) operation to query the region ID.

description.zh: 当前用户可见的步骤名。
description.en: The name of the step visible to the user.

description.zh: 操作名，值为[DescribeHistoryTasks](~~2639186~~)得到的actionInfo内相应状态对应的操作action名称。
description.en: The action name that corresponds to the state described in the actionInfo parameter of the [DescribeHistoryTasks](~~2639186~~) operation.

description.zh: 任务id，多个英文逗号分隔，最多支持10个。
description.en: The task ID. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). You can specify up to 10 task IDs.

title.zh: 任务中心修改任务信息

descriptions.zh: 根据任务当前状态进行相关操作，支持的操作需根据  接口获得的任务actionInfo识别。
descriptions.en: The actions performed by this operation for a task vary based on the current state of the task. The supported actions for a task can be obtained from the value of the actionInfo parameter in the DescribeHistoryTasks operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds modify-task-info --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --task-id t-83br18hlpdrw3uxxxx --step-name exec_task --task-action modifySwitchTime --action-params recoverMode_:_immediate --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dds ModifyTaskInfo --region cn-hangzhou --TaskId 't-83br18hlpdrw3uxxxx' --TaskAction modifySwitchTime --ActionParams 'recoverMode_:_immediate' --StepName exec_task --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
